title: Three gates before your data
caption: A connection passes the network door, then proves who it is using pg_hba.conf and SCRAM, then faces ACL and row security checks before it touches table data.

title: One login, then a SELECT
caption: Follow the numbers: the client connects, the first matching pg_hba.conf line picks SCRAM, the stored verifier proves the password, and then each SELECT is checked by ACLs and row security.

badges.meaning: Client connects to the postmaster socket (psql -U alice)
Postmaster forks a backend and may negotiate TLS
check_hba walks pg_hba.conf and the first matching line wins
The stored verifier is loaded from pg_authid
Proof is accepted and the session role is set
A SELECT arrives and the ACL check runs (aclchk.c)
Row level security adds policy filters, so only allowed rows come back

title: pg_hba.conf lines and ACL entries
caption: A pg_hba.conf line is read left to right as TYPE, DATABASE, USER, ADDRESS, METHOD and the first match wins, while an ACL entry reads grantee=privileges/grantor.
